props.content: See what South Orange County cat owners are saying about Cats Luv Us.

“We have been taking our cats to Cats Luv Us for over 10 years. The staff is incredibly knowledgeable and truly loves cats. Our senior cat has special dietary needs and they handle everything perfectly. I cannot imagine trusting anyone else with our fur babies.”

Patricia G.

Laguna Niguel, CA

“First time boarding our kitten and the team made us feel so at ease. They sent us photos every day and our kitten seemed happy and playful in every one. The facility is spotless and the cat-only environment really makes a difference. Will definitely be back!”

Michael & Jennifer L.

Mission Viejo, CA

“The grooming service here is outstanding. My Persian gets matted so easily and Cats Luv Us always does a beautiful job. The lion cut they gave him looks fantastic and he seems so much more comfortable. The groomers are patient and gentle even with my very fussy boy.”

Dana Point, CA

“I travel for work about once a month and Cats Luv Us has become my go-to. The VIP membership is totally worth it — guaranteed holiday availability and the daily photo updates give me such peace of mind. My cat, Luna, actually seems to enjoy her stays!”

“We adopted a very shy rescue cat and were nervous about boarding her. The staff at Cats Luv Us took extra time to make her comfortable, gave her hiding spots and quiet attention, and by the time we picked her up she was actually purring for them. These people truly understand cats.”

Aliso Viejo, CA

“The daycare program has been a game changer for our cat, Simba. He was getting into everything when left alone and now he goes to daycare three times a week. He comes home tired and happy. The structured play sessions and socialization have made him a much better-adjusted cat.”

Rachel & Tom B.

Lake Forest, CA

“Great facility and wonderful staff. The only reason for 4 stars instead of 5 is that holiday booking fills up very fast, so you need to plan well in advance. But the quality of care is absolutely top-notch. Our two cats have been going here for years.”

San Juan Capistrano, CA

“After a bad experience at another boarding facility that also housed dogs, I switched to Cats Luv Us and the difference is night and day. My cat used to come home stressed and hiding for days. Now she comes home calm and content. The cat-exclusive environment is everything.”

Laguna Beach, CA

“I boarded my three cats here for a month while renovating my house. The long-term boarding rates are very reasonable and the staff went above and beyond to keep all three cats happy. Weekly updates with photos and health reports gave me total peace of mind during a very stressful time.”

Mission Viejo, CA
